notes.title: Version .021a
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45655932/ef37fd81e72094a0d6b2da4fe9da615bb26d65b7.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Version 0.21a[/b][/h3][p][/p][h3]Bye-bye, post-match stutter[/h3][p]Full-time used to trigger a VHS-style flicker. A squirt of virtual WD-40 later and transitions glide like buttered studs on marble.[/p][h3]
Turf no longer 5-star by default[/h3][p]The numbers were juiced, so every ground looked like Wembley in April. Now pitch quality reflects reality, muddy parks play like muddy parks, pristine cathedrals stay plush (and energy drain rises when the grass turns brown).[/p][h3]
Line-ups minus the “No. 12 curse”[/h3][p]The game checked player #12 as if he were a starter; if he was crocked, you got locked out of the next fixture. Fixed: dodgy subs no longer cancel match-day.[/p][p][b]Roadmap tease:[/b] fall below [b]seven[/b] fit men and you’ll soon get a choice—[/p][olist][*][p]Draft random youth lads, [b]or[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Forfeit, eat a fine, lose morale and take a 0-3.
Civilised chaos is coming.[/p][/*][/olist][h3]Divisions now in proper order[/h3][p]“Fourth” showed up as First and vice-versa... total shambles. It’s now logically [b]First, Second, Third, Fourth[/b].[/p]

notes.title: Version .021
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45655932/ef37fd81e72094a0d6b2da4fe9da615bb26d65b7.png"][/img]

[b]Version .021
[/b][/p][p][b]Faster Matchdays[/b][/p][p]Our devs had some coffee, broke a few chairs, and optimized the matchday system. Now jumping from one round to the next is so smooth, even the kit man didn’t notice the next game had already kicked off.[/p][p][b]Snappy Player Database[/b][/p][p]We’ve performed surgery on the player list system: showing 2000 players no longer turns your PC into a toaster. Less lag, less memory usage, more glory. The database scroll flies—even if Algodonales’ striker still doesn’t.[/p][p][b]Minor Fixes (but with love)[/b][/p][p]Tweaks to the interface, visual polish, and several bugs bravely reported by our noble testers (thanks, legends!). The bug report doc is now a bit lighter, and the game is a bit more playable than yesterday.[/p]

notes.title: Version .020
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45655932/ef37fd81e72094a0d6b2da4fe9da615bb26d65b7.png"][/img]
Versión .020

[b]Injuries & Suspensions[/b][/p][p]A fresh layer of chaos: players can now break, strain or earn themselves a holiday via the ref’s pocket.[/p][list][*][p][b]No kick-off with crocks or bad boys[/b]. If a starter is injured or banned, shuffle the XI or forfeit.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Injuries[/b] arise when you flog energy, lunge like a lumberjack or play on a Chernobyl pitch. 

[i]Low stamina + brutal tackles + swampy turf = enforced spa break.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Suspensions[/b] work the same (out of the line-up) with extra misery: the vacant slot can’t be filled mid-match if the red card happened on the pitch.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Booking maths[/b][/p][list][*][p]5 yellows accumulated = 1-match ban.[/p][/*][*][p]Straight red or two yellows = off today [b]plus[/b] one more match.
The ref’s new toybox dishes cards with 1993 gusto, so mind those crunchers.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Weather that bites[/b][/p][list][*][p]Atmosphere is no longer flavour text: heavy rain, boggy ground or heatwave now guzzle energy and crank up injury odds. Try pinging a ball on a waterlogged cabbage patch and watch morale (and ankles) disappear.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]
Energy & Morale tweaks[/b][/p][list][*][p]Field condition, weather and play style now feed directly into stamina drain.[/p][/*][*][p]Assigned roles give the lucky lad a morale bump, but spamming five roles on one bloke does nothing extra.[/p][/*][*][p]Captain and vice-captain can’t be the same person anymore (nice try).
[/p][/*][/list][quote][p][b][i]Boots laced, lads... this grass means business.[/i][/b][/p][/quote]

notes.title: Version .019a
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45655932/ef37fd81e72094a0d6b2da4fe9da615bb26d65b7.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Version .019a[/b]
[/p][h3]Leagues for Every Taste (and Screw)[/h3][p]The DMT universe just got bigger! When you create a database now, you don’t only choose how many teams or stands… you decide what planet your players come from:[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][th][p]League Type[/p][/th][th][p]What You Get[/p][/th][th][p]DMT Flavor[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Men’s[/b][/p][/td][td][p]Classic ’90s moustaches, “El Killer,” and locker-room debates over whether tortilla should have onions.[/p][/td][td][p][i]“This is old-school football, señor!”[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Women’s[/b][/p][/td][td][p]120 fresh names + 100 killer nicknames: “La Pantera,” “La Valquiria”… zero fear of the top corner.[/p][/td][td][p]More accuracy, less drama, same fighting spirit.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Mixed[/b][/p][/td][td][p]Total cocktail: him, her, and whoever dares, all on the same pitch.[/p][/td][td][p]Equal chances, unequal nutmegs.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Cyborgs[/b][/p][/td][td][p]120 units—R2-D-something, MechaNova, QuantumForge. They don’t sweat, but they do overheat.[/p][/td][td][p]Watch out on corners: they reboot after the 70th minute.[/p][/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: Versión .019
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45655932/ef37fd81e72094a0d6b2da4fe9da615bb26d65b7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Version 0.019 – Divisions[/h3][quote][p][i]“Glory’s up top, tears are down below…and the lift never stops.”[/i][/p][/quote][p]
Leagues that no longer fit on one sheet[/p][p][b]Division system switched on[/b][/p][list][*][p]Up to [b]four tiers[/b] (default is two).[/p][/*][*][p]Tweak the number in [i]Custom League[/i] and watch the database sort itself out, big boys upstairs, plucky minnows downstairs (roughly speaking).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]’93 Rule revived (at least how it was in Spain at that ancient time)[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Top three[/b] in every division go up.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bottom three[/b] go down.[/p][/*][*][p]It cascades all the way (yes, Second → Third → Fourth).[/p][/*][*][p]Expect chairmen sweating buckets by May.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Tactics with fresh hair-gel[/b][/p][list][*][p]Game-Plan carousel tidied; one dusty option sent to the knackers’ yard.[/p][/*][*][p]Say hello to [b]Conserve[/b] (aka “Dosificado”): sips energy but don’t count on silky tiki-taka or an ironclad back line.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]A fussier transfer market[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Thirty-somethings[/b]: once you hit 30 the price tag starts to sag, life’s tough and knees creak.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Form stars[/b]: prolific scorers, assist kings and brick-wall keepers see their value shoot up. Performance matters.
[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Pull on your Sunday trackie, scan the table…and remember: in DMT the real trick isn’t getting to the top flight, it’s staying there without flogging the team bus.[/i][/p]

notes.title: Version 0.18d
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45655932/ef37fd81e72094a0d6b2da4fe9da615bb26d65b7.png"][/img][b]
Version 0.18d – Game Plans[/b][/p][p]A couple of fresh tweaks focused on match strategy:[/p][list][*][p]You can now view the direct impact each Game Plan has on your team’s attacking and defensive ratings.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new Game Plan, [b]Conserve[/b] (formerly “Dosificado”): it cuts energy consumption but also dials back both offence and defence.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 018c
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45655932/ef37fd81e72094a0d6b2da4fe9da615bb26d65b7.png"][/img]
[b][i]v[/i][/b].[b][i]018c[/i][/b]

A couple of fresh toggles for the database generator.
[/p][p]Because we like keeping DMT bang-up-to-date, and occasionally surrender to pure silliness... you’ll now find two brand-new options in the generator menu. They won’t make the game any [i]better[/i] (strictly speaking), but we’re sure at least one brave tester will put them to glorious misuse.[/p][list][*][p]One switch sprinkles extra-daft nicknames onto players.[/p][/*][*][p]The other summons a fearsome, super-stacked team: breeze to the title [i]with[/i] them, or face them as the league’s final boss.[/p][/*][/list][p]As ever, the choice is entirely yours. Have fun, and do tell us how it all goes horribly right (or delightfully wrong).[/p]
